summary: Deployed nginx:alpine as a rootless podman container on node1, running under the unprivileged `appsvc` account, published on port 8080, managed by a systemd user quadlet (webapp.container) wired into default.target via lingering — no active login session required. Verified boot-time auto-start and full recovery across a node restart with a changed boot_id.
actions_performed: Created unprivileged user appsvc with auto-assigned subuid/subgid ranges
Enabled systemd lingering for appsvc (loginctl enable-linger)
Verified rootless podman functions for appsvc without a login session
Wrote a podman quadlet unit ~/.config/containers/systemd/webapp.container publishing 8080:80
Started the service via systemctl --user and confirmed it registers in default.target.wants (auto-start at boot)
Verified HTTP 200 on $NODE_IP:8080 and no active login session (loginctl list-sessions shows only the manager session)
Captured pre-restart boot_id, rebooted node1 with systemctl reboot --no-block, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id
Verified post-restart: lingering still enabled, user@1000 manager running, webapp.service active, HTTP 200 on 8080 with no login session

evidence.requirement: Container runs as unprivileged appsvc user, serving on port 8080
evidence.summary: appsvc user created; rootless podman confirmed (Rootless=true); webapp.service running nginx; curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200; ss shows listener on 8080

evidence.requirement: Starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
evidence.summary: Lingering enabled for appsvc; user@1000.service (user manager) runs independent of login; quadlet generator symlinked webapp.service into default.target.wants so it auto-starts on boot; loginctl list-sessions shows only a manager-class session with no tty/seat, i.e. no interactive login
Captured pre-restart boot_id a70d7f83-6867-4c91-851d-7a1228689bb3 alongside direct proof of healthy container (active service, HTTP 200)

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot --no-block acknowledged before disconnect; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id f4e419b2-78b1-4962-94f9-477bcb40c11c differs from baseline, proving an actual restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: lingering, service, and HTTP endpoint all healthy without login session
evidence.summary: After reboot, Linger=yes persisted, only a manager-class session exists (no login), webapp.service is active, and curl to port 8080 returns HTTP 200
